sources.offline: pyproject.toml, package.json, package-lock.json, vendor/manifest.json, kit hash records, THIRD_PARTY_NOTICES.md, upstreams/registry.yaml, research/landscape.json, published Markdown

limits: A clean report is not proof of safety: advisory databases (OSV, the npm registry) only know what has been reported.
Licences come from licence files and registry metadata (GitHub, PyPI, npm), matched by keyword; they are not a legal review.
Link checks see status codes and redirects, not content: a parked or replaced page that answers 200 passes. Domain expiry is not checked.
GitHub links are checked at repository level; a missing file or anchor inside a live repository is not seen.
Python versions are checked at the newest release and the lowest release our range allows, not at every version in between.
Offline mode checks only what the checkout shows (pins, hashes, licence files, lockfile, link schemes, install advice).

findings.subject: webkit:file-parsers
findings.title: the vendored fflate 0.6.9 has 1 known advisory
findings.evidence: GHSA-px8p-9vwx-vf98 (medium, fixed in 0.6.11): fflate unzipSync can enter an infinite loop when parsing malformed ZIP64 archives
findings.action: Update the vendored copy to >=0.6.11: new files, new SHA-256 records and notices, then the web kit browser suites (it ships to every project site that copies the kit).

findings.subject: webkit:mermaid
findings.title: the vendored mermaid 11.4.1 has 9 known advisories
findings.evidence: GHSA-2v8p-3f2j-5mp7 (medium, fixed in 11.16.1): Mermaid XY Charts are vulnerable to an infinite loop DoS; GHSA-6m6c-36f7-fhxh (medium, fixed in 11.15.0): Mermaid Gantt Charts are vulnerable to an Infinite Loop DoS; GHSA-6x64-9x62-f2gx (medium, fixed in 11.16.1): Mermaid allows CSS injection applying to sibling elements of the diagram; GHSA-7rqq-prvp-x9jh (medium, fixed in 11.10.0): Mermaid improperly sanitizes sequence diagram labels leading to XSS; GHSA-87f9-hvmw-gh4p (medium, fixed in 11.15.0): Mermaid: Improper sanitization of configuration leads to CSS injection; GHSA-8gwm-58g9-j8pw (medium, fixed in 11.10.0): Mermaid does not properly sanitize architecture diagram iconText leading to XSS; GHSA-ghcm-xqfw-q4vr (medium, fixed in 11.15.0): Mermaid: Improper sanitization of `classDef` in state diagrams leads to HTML injection; GHSA-xcj9-5m2h-648r (medium, fixed in 11.15.0): Mermaid: Improper sanitization of `classDefs` in diagrams leads to CSS injection and 1 more
findings.action: Update the vendored copy to >=11.16.1: new files, new SHA-256 records and notices, then the web kit browser suites (it ships to every project site that copies the kit).

findings.subject: pypi:pillow
findings.title: our range allows pillow 10.0.0, which has 53 known advisories
findings.evidence: GHSA-332p-7hrc-92wf (critical, fixed in 13.0.0): Pillow: Heap buffer overflow in _tiffWriteProc when saving TIFF to BytesIO; GHSA-3f63-hfp8-52jq (critical, fixed in 10.2.0): Arbitrary Code Execution in Pillow; GHSA-5x8w-8jj5-q52h (critical, fixed in 13.0.0): Pillow: Heap buffer overflow in FlashPix (FPX) JPEG decoding leads to code execution; GHSA-8g5g-8vmr-9782 (critical, fixed in 13.0.0): Pillow: Heap buffer overflow in ImagingJpegDecode; GHSA-w889-685w-c8fh (critical, fixed in 13.0.0): Pillow: Argument Injection in Ghostscript call, potentially leading into RCE; GHSA-22hg-r758-rrw9 (high, fixed in 13.0.0): Pillow: Infinite loop in MIC n_frames when the embedded TIFF; GHSA-27h8-gf7j-v5hc (high, fixed in 13.0.0): Pillow: NULL dereference in ImagingExpand via rank filters on zero-size images; GHSA-3j72-p6qg-6xp7 (high, fixed in 13.0.0): Pillow: TarIO negative size field causes infinite CPU-spin loop and 45 more
findings.action: Raise the floor to >=13.0.0 in pyproject.toml.

findings.subject: pypi:vtk
findings.title: our range allows vtk 9.2.2, which has 3 known advisories
findings.evidence: PYSEC-2025-224 (medium, fixed in 9.5.1): Kitware VTK (Visualization Toolkit) up to 9.5.0 is vulnerable to Buffer Overflow in vtkGLTFDocumentLoader. The vulnerability occurs in the BufferDataExtractionW; PYSEC-2025-225 (medium, fixed in 9.5.1): Kitware VTK (Visualization Toolkit) through 9.5.0 contains a heap buffer overflow vulnerability in vtkGLTFDocumentLoader. When processing specially crafted GLTF; PYSEC-2025-226 (medium, fixed in 9.5.1): Kitware VTK (Visualization Toolkit) through 9.5.0 contains a heap use-after-free vulnerability in vtkGLTFDocumentLoader. The vulnerability manifests during mesh
findings.action: Raise the floor to >=9.5.1 in pyproject.toml.
